test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Express 0.45overline {235} as a function.
solution:
Concept used:

.BCoverline{DEF} = (BCDEF - BC)/(99900)

Calculation:

.45overline{235}

⇒ (45235-45)/(99900)

⇒ (45190)/(99900)

⇒ (4519)/(9990)

∴ The correct answer is (4519)/(9990).
